mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_tags WHERE deleted = 0 AND anchor_embedding IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_tags SET topic = #{topic}, anchor_embedding = COALESCE(#{anchorHalfvec}::halfvec, anchor_embedding), anchor_tokens = COALESCE(#{anchorTokens}, anchor_tokens), needs_review = false, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE memory_tags SET deleted = 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE memory_summaries SET tag_id = #{survivor} WHERE tag_id = #{loser}
UPDATE memory_conflicts SET tag_id = #{survivor} WHERE tag_id = #{loser}
UPDATE memory_turns SET tag_ids = array_replace(tag_ids, #{loser}::bigint, #{survivor}::bigint) WHERE #{loser}::bigint = ANY(tag_ids)
UPDATE memory_project_entries SET tag_ids = array_replace(tag_ids, #{loser}::bigint, #{survivor}::bigint) WHERE #{loser}::bigint = ANY(tag_ids)
